title: Formal completion of the core by split-retract equations
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D with field k and characteristic p, a prime l different from p, an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l in an independent universe, and a separated finite-type scheme X over k. Use the actual raw rational finite stages, scalar extensions, tensor comparisons and common-stage pair category of [def-sf-common-stage-verdier-data]. For DualityData B satisfying CoreProperties: finite beta coherence, additivity, finite coefficient normalization and Omega-linearity, literal finite objects and identity comparisons, scalar and biduality compatibility, coherent omega comparisons, included finite evaluation and evaluation naturality, evaluation naturality and biduality naturality imply the three split-retract equations of DualityProperties. Thus completeCore constructs a Duality with the same data.

source.place: Final coefficient-transport paragraph; core descent retained steps 1--5 and formal retract restriction step 10

proof.text: Copy the eleven core equations. Factor tensor(i,Dp) as tensor(i,1) followed by tensor(1,Dp); evaluation naturality for p and the split equation cancel this expression to evaluation at the retract.
Naturality of biduality and its inverse, followed by the same split equation, proves the two remaining equations.
